crossRefs.note: Behold, you have made my days hand widths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath.”
“Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn’t know who shall…
Surely men of low degree are just a breath, and men of high degree are a lie. In the balances they will go up. They are…
Remember how short my time is, for what vanity you have created all the children of men!
How much more, those who dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, who are crushed before the moth!
“Man, who is born of a woman, is of few days, and full of trouble.
“Vanity of vanities,” says the Preacher; “Vanity of vanities, all is vanity.”
I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and behold, all is vanity and a chasing after wind.
“Vanity of vanities,” says the Preacher. “All is vanity!”
My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.
As for man, his days are like grass. As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.
For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.
I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.
For we must die, and are like water spilled on the ground, which can’t be gathered up again; neither does God take away…
For we are strangers before you, and foreigners, as all our fathers were. Our days on the earth are as a shadow, and…
(For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days on earth are a shadow.)
But it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he lengthen days like a shadow, because he doesn’t fear God.

translations.web: Man is like a breath. His days are like a shadow that passes away.
translations.bsb: Man is like a breath; his days are like a passing shadow.
translations.kjv: Man is like to vanity: his days are as a shadow that passeth away.
translations.asv: Man is like to vanity: His days are as a shadow that passeth away.
